crossRefs.note: When he humbled himself, Yahweh’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good…
Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is…
For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it…
He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.
who sets his heart to seek God, Yahweh, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification…
For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

translations.web: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”
translations.bsb: However, some good is found in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.”
translations.kjv: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.
translations.asv: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast put away the Asheroth out of the land, and hast set thy heart to seek God.
